messages.author: 865451ff948b0e2a
messages.subject: RSourceOnStartup
parts:
Hi,

I am using RSourceOnStartup in the r.conf


#includes
RSourceOnStartup "/var/www/r/include.R"


In the include.R I do a simple load of a library that I plan to use
and nothing else.

library(phpSerialize)


Then in a regular R file I do this:

x<-rnorm(10)
x = phpSerialize(x)
print(x)

When I refresh the page it works printing the result 9 times out of
10. From time to time I get this error as a result of the library not
being loaded.

<div style="background-color:#eee; padding: 20px 20px 20px 20px; font-
size: 14pt; border: 2px solid red;"><p>Oops!!! <b>rApache</b> has
something to tell you. View source and read the HTML comments at the
end.</p></div>
<!--
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) :
could not find function "phpSerialize"
Traceback:
3: eval(expr, envir, enclos)
2: eval(i, envir)
1: sys.source(file = "/var/www/r/test/1.R", envir = .rAenv)
-->

I am expecting that the include file will be evaluated 100% of the
times.
Is there a better way to permanently load a library, or am I doing
something wrong here?

Thanks

issues is fixed today after I restarted my working station/server.
I did not do anything else special to solve this fluke.

anything wrong please advice, I am not very good at this.

<Location /RApacheInfo>
SetHandler r-info
</Location>
# hangs if the modules are not available
#REvalOnStartup "library(phpSerialize);"
#test
RSourceOnStartup "/var/www/r/include.R"
<Directory /var/www/r>
SetHandler r-script
RHandler sys.source
</Directory>

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: RSourceOnStartup
parts:
Okay, a good thing to remember here is that you are dealing with a
multi-process program: apache. Tasks aren't always going to be
synchronized. That's why I like testing and debugging rApache while
running apache with the -X flag which makes it run single-process.

Best,

Jeff
